title: Roy Eldridge's challenge at the Metropole
summary: Eldridge demanded he play certain tunes; JCH objected that it was no musicianship and walked off.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: That's a good way to feel.
What was that about Roy Eldridge?

We were playing at the Metropole and Roy, you know how he comes in? He said, "I got something for you. Play this." (....) I said, "That's no musicianship. You shouldn't do things like that." So he switched to another cut 'Body and Soul'. "Play this; play that." Buster got mad and went home and I walked off too...
